title: Sous Chef: Schedule the Line
briefing: Four cooks. Eight prep tasks. Two hours until doors open. Assign smart or burn labor dollars.

expertRecipe.name: Prep Schedule Standard
expertRecipe.platingStandard: All 8 tasks assigned, no cook idle, total labor under $144 (4 cooks x 2 hrs x $18/hr).

steps.instruction: Assess all 8 tasks by time and skill required.
steps.whyExplanation: Assigning a 90-minute braise to a cook who has 30 minutes left wastes labor and delays service.

steps.instruction: Assign protein prep first (longest lead time).
steps.whyExplanation: Proteins need marination, tempering, or brining time. Late start = raw protein at service.
Sauces reduce and need time to develop. A rushed sauce is a thin sauce.

steps.instruction: Assign cold prep and garnishes last.
steps.whyExplanation: Cold items done too early wilt or oxidize. Herbs cut at 10am are brown by noon.

steps.instruction: Verify no cook is double-booked during the same window.
steps.whyExplanation: Overlapping assignments mean one task gets neglected. That's the task that burns.

criticalControlPoints.consequence: Every hour of unplanned overtime costs $27 (time-and-a-half) and erodes margins.
